stem: Which quotation best supports the thesis of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: Venice’s natural strategic position on the sea, along with its special design, helped make it a wealthy city. (paragraph 7)

options.label: B
options.text: The centerpiece was the S-shaped Grand Canal, which served, as it still does, as Venice’s main “boulevard.” (paragraph 8)

options.label: C
options.text: What had once been a lowly marsh had become a masterpiece of urban development and an example of how humans can depend on, benefit from, and modify the natural environment at the same time. (paragraph 8)

options.label: D
options.text: Those ancient pilings still provide firm support for Venice’s beautiful buildings, which in turn support Venice’s tourist industry. (paragraph 10)

visual_elements: A Venice’s natural strategic position on the sea, along with its special design, helped make it a wealthy city. (paragraph 7)
B The centerpiece was the S-shaped Grand Canal, which served, as it still does, as Venice’s main “boulevard.” (paragraph 8)

C What had once been a lowly marsh had become a masterpiece of urban development and an example of how humans can depend on, benefit from, and modify the natural environment at the same time. (paragraph 8)
D Those ancient pilings still provide firm support for Venice’s beautiful buildings, which in turn support Venice’s tourist industry. (paragraph 10)
